references.text: Gives detailed instructions for the grain offering and drink offering that were to accompany the burnt offerings, with specific amounts of flour, oil, and wine based on the type of animal sacrificed.
Describes the drink offering that was to accompany the burnt offering, a parallel to the prescribed sacrifices during the Feast of Tabernacles.
Identical wording regarding the grain offering and drink offering 'according to the regulation' for the preceding day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
The same formula is used for the second day of the Feast of Tabernacles concerning the grain offering and drink offering for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
Repeats the same instruction for the fourth day of the Feast of Tabernacles, showing the consistent pattern throughout the festival.
The same wording for the fifth day of the Feast of Tabernacles with the grain offering and drink offering according to the prescribed number.
Continues the pattern for the sixth day of the Feast of Tabernacles with the same instructions for the additional offerings.
Summarizes the Lord's feasts with burnt offerings, grain offerings, peace offerings, and drink offerings, each on its proper day.
